Quick Answer: What is Anchor Roma Switch, 10A used for?

Anchor Roma Switch, 10A is a compact 1-module electrical switch, designed for controlling lights, fans, and medium-power appliances with reliable switching at 240V, handling up to 2400W.

  • Current Rating: 10 Ampere
  • Voltage: 240V AC
  • Module Size: 1 Module (compact)
  • Brand: Anchor Panasonic Roma Classic
  • Maximum Load: 2400W at 240V

Anchor Roma Switch, 10A is part of India's most trusted modular electrical range, offering reliable switching control for everyday residential and commercial applications. Its compact 1-module design maximizes space efficiency while providing robust performance for lighting circuits and medium-power appliances.

The Roma series has been a household name in India for decades, known for its durability, safety, and value pricing. This 10A switch delivers consistent performance with Anchor Panasonic's proven quality, making it the go-to choice for electricians, builders, and homeowners across the country.

Technical Specifications (Quick Reference)

Specification Details
Brand Anchor Panasonic Roma Classic
Current Rating 10 Ampere
Voltage 240V AC
Module Size 1 Module
Maximum Load 2400W at 240V

Recommended Applications

  • Lighting Control: Perfect for LED lights, CFLs, tube lights, and all types of residential lighting
  • Ceiling Fans: Suitable for on/off control of standard ceiling fans (use with separate regulator for speed control)
  • Exhaust Fans: Control bathroom and kitchen exhaust fans
  • Small Appliances: Switch control for low to medium-power devices
  • Residential Installations: Standard switch for homes, apartments, and rental properties
  • Commercial Spaces: Economical choice for offices, shops, and commercial buildings

Installation Guidelines

  1. Power Isolation: Turn off the main power supply and verify with a voltage tester before beginning work
  2. Wiring Connection: Connect incoming live wire to one terminal and outgoing wire to the other terminal using 1.5-2.5 sq mm copper wire
  3. Module Installation: Insert the switch module into the Anchor Roma plate, ensuring it clicks securely into place
  4. Testing: Restore power and test the switch operation to ensure proper functionality before final use

1) What is the maximum wattage this 10A switch can handle?

At 240V, this 10A switch can safely handle up to 2400 watts (10A × 240V). This is suitable for multiple LED bulbs, CFLs, ceiling fans, or a combination of lights on a single circuit.

2) Can I use this switch for a ceiling fan?

Yes, you can use this switch for on/off control of ceiling fans. However, for speed control, you'll need a separate fan regulator. The 10A rating is more than sufficient for standard ceiling fans which typically draw 70-100W.

3) What is the difference between 6A and 10A switches?

A 10A switch can handle higher loads (2400W vs 1440W), making it more versatile. While 6A is sufficient for most lighting, 10A provides extra capacity for fans, multiple lights, or future expansion without needing to upgrade.

4) Is Anchor Roma suitable for modern homes?

Absolutely! Roma is India's most popular modular range and continues to be widely used in modern homes. It offers proven reliability, safety compliance, and excellent value, making it ideal for both new construction and renovations.

5) Can I replace my old switch with this Roma switch?

Yes, but you'll need the complete Anchor Roma modular system including the plate and frame. This switch is part of a modular system and cannot be used standalone. Ensure your existing wall box is compatible with modular fittings.

6) What wire size should I use for installation?

For 10A circuits, use 1.5 sq mm to 2.5 sq mm copper wire depending on the load and cable run length. For lighting circuits, 1.5 sq mm is typically sufficient. Always follow local electrical codes.
